prediction.description: Review of neuropeptide effects on human brain activity, including a new coordinate-based ALE meta-analysis of intranasal arginine-vasopressin in healthy men during social behavior.

design.description: Coordinate-based meta-analysis of nine published double-blind, placebo-controlled studies, collapsing between- and within-subject designs, behavioral tasks, and signal-change directions. No new participant allocation or acquisition was performed.

analyses.name: Laird et al. (2011)
analyses.definition: ALE meta-analysis of all data, collapsing between and within subject designs, the type of behavioral tasks employed and the direction of signal change.
interpretations: The resulting analysis included 347 subjects and 65 reported coordinates and revealed three clusters located in the frontal cortex (Brodmann areas 8, 9, and 47).
It suggests that IN AVP modulates cortical areas during social behavior.

details.reason_first_class_type_not_used: Coordinate-based ALE meta-analysis tests spatial convergence across published experiments rather than a primary-data mass-univariate model.

analyses.model_representation_notes: The supplied parse label is retained, but the coordinates are the authors' ALE results, not coordinates from Laird et al. (2011). The paper reports 347 subjects, whereas the supplied parse lists only three foci. The positive cell denotes significant spatial convergence, not a uniformly positive pharmacological effect; signal directions were collapsed.

groups.name: healthy men
groups.description: Aggregate sample of 347 subjects from nine published intranasal AVP fMRI studies; not a newly recruited cohort.
inclusion_criteria: Studies involving intranasal AVP administration before fMRI
exclusion_criteria: Studies with restrictions on regions of interest
groups.recruitment_method: PubMed literature search for vasopressin AND fMRI, followed by selection of eligible published studies.
groups.sample_source_reference: Zink et al. 2010, 2011; Rilling et al. 2012; Brunnlieb et al. 2013a, b, 2016; Lee et al. 2013; Feng et al. 2015; Gozzi et al. 2017

tasks.name: social behavior
tasks.description: Meta-analytic task context spanning cooperative games and emotion processing paradigms; task types were collapsed rather than tested separately.

model_estimations.model_settings: Revised ALE algorithm; default parameters automatically selected by GingerALE for optimum FWHM. All data collapsed across designs, behavioral tasks, and signal-change directions.

terms.name: meta-analytic input
terms.source_definition: 65 reported coordinates from nine studies, collapsing between and within subject designs, behavioral tasks, and direction of signal change.

measures.specific_metric: Spatial convergence of reported fMRI coordinates

coordinate_sets.description: Three frontal clusters from the authors' ALE meta-analysis: (4, 39, 25), (39, 29, -4), and (-8, 37, 39). The supplied parse label incorrectly attributes these coordinates to Laird et al. (2011).
